description: Information architecture: product areas and navigation paths in user-facing language. No CSS/XPath/selectors. Reconcile wording with live UI in Stage 3.

feature_paths.primary_path: Launch web trading URL → sign-in / login form → submit credentials → authenticated shell loads
feature_paths.shell_note: Pre-auth; path labels may read Sign in, Log in, or SSO.

feature_paths.primary_path: Authenticated shell → application header → account or portfolio selector (dropdown or control)
alt_paths: Switch account from context that prompts for header selection (e.g. order entry)
blocked_unless: At least one visible account or portfolio

feature_paths.primary_path: Main workspace → Watchlist widget or panel (list/grid view)
alt_paths: Add Watchlist widget from workspace or widget gallery if not already on layout

feature_paths.primary_path: Workspace → Chart (Advanced Charts / TradingView) widget → select or link instrument
alt_paths: Open chart from Instrument page or watchlist context menu

feature_paths.primary_path: Workspace → Market Depth (Level 2) widget → active symbol from selection or watchlist
alt_paths: Open depth from Instrument page side panels if offered
blocked_unless: Entitled depth for symbol where applicable

feature_paths.primary_path: Workspace → Order Entry (order ticket) widget → ensure trading account selected when prompted
alt_paths: Launch OE from chart or instrument context
Embedded WebBroker: Order Entry region per dealer layout
blocked_unless: Trading account selected when product requires it

feature_paths.primary_path: Workspace → Orders widget (card or list view) → expand or navigate to full orders view
alt_paths: Instrument page → Portfolio tab → Orders section

feature_paths.primary_path: Dealer WebBroker workspace → Order Book widget (internal / working orders)
blocked_unless: Dealer or back-office style shell with Order Book entitlement
feature_paths.shell_note: Primarily webbroker / dealer layout; may be absent on retail-only skin.

feature_paths.primary_path: Workspace → Position Book (Positions) widget or grid
Workspace → Account list / Portfolio metrics widget (values follow header portfolio or account selection)
blocked_unless: Header context selection for multi-account users

feature_paths.primary_path: User menu or Settings entry → Order Defaults (default order parameters)
alt_paths: Settings sidebar → Trading or Orders → Order Defaults if relabeled

feature_paths.primary_path: Settings or profile area → Market data subscriptions (entitlements / packages)
alt_paths: Dedicated Market Data entry from main menu on some skins

feature_paths.primary_path: Global: transient notification area (typically upper-right after events)
Workspace → Messages widget (chronological feed with date groupings)
alt_paths: Main menu → Messages if surfaced as a route

feature_paths.primary_path: Search symbol or open from Watchlist → Instrument (details) page → tabs (e.g. Portfolio, Stats)
Account-level actions (header or account toolbar) → Flatten all / Close all positions (confirm destructive prompt)
blocked_unless: Account with open risk or working orders

feature_paths.primary_path: Workspace → Account Transactions widget (activity / transactions table)
WebBroker shell → dealer workspace layout → dxTrade-embedded widget regions (Order Entry, Orders, etc.)
feature_paths.shell_note: Layout is deployment-specific; use concept feature IDs for individual widgets inside the shell.

feature_paths.primary_path: External: Confluence CT → Cornertrader Requirements (page 342171997) → child specification pages
External: Confluence DR → dxBro Requirements (page 254224494) → descendant WEB/mobile specs
